item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 26, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs of Mexico Roberto Velasco Alvarez
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇲🇽 On September 26, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs of Mexico Roberto Velasco Alvarez held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . The Ministers exchanged views on current international and regional issues , with a focus on cooperation at the #UN , #G20 , #APEC and other multilateral forums. The Sides reaffirmed Russia and Mexico’s commitment to the principles and norms of international law and to collectively seeking solutions to current global challenges. Particular attention was paid to further advancing bilateral political dialogue, expanding trade and economic cooperation, and strengthening cultural and humanitarian ties. #RussiaMexico

item.title: 💬 Russia's Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova During Sergey Lavrov’s meeting
item.description: 💬 Russia's Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova : During Sergey Lavrov’s meeting with German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul , held at the request of the German side, a report by the International Public Tribunal on the Crimes of Ukrainian Neo-Nazis on the #BuchaHoax lay on the negotiating table. 👉 Russia's Foreign Minister had spoken about it in detail only recently. The evidence presented in the investigation exposes what it describes as a cynical falsification orchestrated by the Kiev regime and its Western sponsors. The title speaks for itself: “Heirs of Goebbels: Falsification of the Events in Bucha and Bloody Staged Performances of the Kiev Regime” . Wadephul discreetly covered the report with his notebook and pretended not to notice it – as if the comparison with Goebbels had nothing to do with them. But the point was perfectly clear to everyone 👉 “THE TRUTH HURTS” .

item.title: ❗️ #Announcement Russia's Victory Museum in Moscow is hosting the “Ordinary Nazism”
item.description: #Announcement ❗️ Russia's Victory Museum in Moscow is hosting the “Ordinary Nazism” exhibition , which traces the origins and evolution of Ukrainian Nazism to the present day. More than 200 exhibits are on display, documenting the atrocities committed by Ukrainian nationalists during #WWII , as well as the mass crimes and terror committed by their modern followers against the people of Ukraine in 2014-2022. LEARN MORE: On the origins of Ukrainian nationalism, the crimes of the OUN-UPA, and the support of the West The exhibits include archival materials from Germany dating from the late 1930s and early 1940s, documents and photographs, alongside case files documenting crimes against humanity committed by Ukrainian nationalists in the Ukrainian SSR. 📄 The “Nazism Today” section features books, uniforms, Ukrainian nationalist propaganda materials and items bearing Nazi symbols, as well as photographs and eyewitness accounts of crimes committed by contemporary neo-Nazis against the people of Ukraine . A central part of the exhibition is an installation dedicated to the children of Donbass who lost their lives . The exhibition features materials from the collections of the Victory Museum, the Donetsk Republican Museum of Local Lore and the Russian State Archive of Social and Political History, as well as the RIA Novosti special project “Donbass. item.description: 🗓 On September 26, at the request of the German side, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly in New York . On these and other issues, Johann Wadephul reiterated the position of the German government that has been repeatedly stated publicly. #UNGA81

item.title: 💬 Russia's Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova Germany’s Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul requested a meeting with Sergey Lavrov on the sidelines of
item.description: 💬 Russia's Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova : Germany’s Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul requested a meeting with Sergey Lavrov on the sidelines of #UNGA81 . We have held dozens of meetings at the UN. Heads of government and Foreign Ministers from countries that the West dismissively refers to as the “jungle” , supposedly because of their low level of democracy, came to meet Sergey Lavrov. And then a representative of the “beautiful garden” , German FM Johann Wadephul , asked for a meeting with Russia’s Foreign Minister. And what do you think happened? His staff demanded restrictions on media access, guarantees that no questions would be asked, no audio recording of the opening remarks, and an embargo on publishing materials . 👉 That is the “Western democracy of the beautiful garden” ...
